kept.title: LLM cache now writes to size-limited ephemeral `/tmp` with no eviction
kept.desc: On Vercel the cache dir becomes `/tmp`, which has a hard size cap (~512MB) shared with everything else in the function instance; `setCachedResult` never prunes or bounds entries, so long-lived warm containers can exhaust `/tmp` and start failing writes (or other `/tmp` users' writes) instead of just missing cache.

kept.title: Comment understates the loss of analytics durability on Vercel
kept.desc: `/tmp` is per-instance, so analytics entries are also split and unreadable across *concurrent* function instances, not merely lost "across cold starts"; readers of `readAnalyticsEntries()` will see partial history even while warm, which the comment (and `dataDir`'s doc) does not convey.
